nodes.name: Vectơ
nodes.description: Một đại lượng toán học có độ lớn và hướng, thường được biểu diễn bằng một đoạn thẳng có hướng.

assignments.rationale: This occurrence defines a vector as a directed line segment, which is the core concept. It is a valid and standard definition.
This occurrence defines a vector as a quantity with magnitude and direction, which is another standard, equivalent description of the same mathematical concept. It should be merged with the first.

This occurrence defines a vector as a mathematical object with length and direction. The original ID 'VEC_TO' is a minor typographical variation of 'VECTO'. The description is consistent with the same core concept. It should be merged.
